steps.label: Retention
steps.sub: 93 days by default, no agent needed

code:
az monitor log-analytics workspace create \
  --resource-group rg-driftwood-eastus-catalog \
  --workspace-name law-driftwood-catalog \
  --location eastus
caption: Once logs flow, KQL can answer "who changed this, and when?"

code:
az monitor metrics alert create \
  --name alert-catalog01-high-cpu \
  --resource-group rg-driftwood-eastus-catalog \
  --scopes <vm-catalog01-resource-id> \
  --condition "avg Percentage CPU > 80" \
  --window-size 5m --evaluation-frequency 1m
caption: Average CPU over 80% for 5 minutes -- the window filters out harmless spikes.

code:
az monitor action-group create \
  --name ag-driftwood-ops \
  --resource-group rg-driftwood-eastus-catalog \
  --action email theo theo.bryant@driftwoodoutdoor.com \
  --action email priya priya.suresh@driftwoodoutdoor.com
caption: Reusable -- the same group can attach to future alerts too.
